title: Only a Little to the Left: A Theory-grounded Measure of Political Bias in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on measuring political bias in LLMs using survey instruments like the World Values Survey and the Political Compass Test. While these instruments include items regarding religious values and moral stances (e.g., abortion, sexual morality), they are used as proxies to calculate political ideological leaning rather than as a benchmark for evaluating religious knowledge, theology, or ethical reasoning.
